def factor_tail_range_vol_of_vol_zscore(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    tr = pd.Series(talib.TRANGE(df_copy["high"], df_copy["low"], df_copy["close"]), index=df_copy.index)
    vol_range = tr.rolling(30, min_periods=15).std()
    avg_range = tr.rolling(60, min_periods=30).mean()
    stress = vol_range / avg_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    stress_mean = stress.rolling(60, min_periods=30).mean()
    stress_std = stress.rolling(60, min_periods=30).std(ddof=1)
    stress_z = (stress - stress_mean) / stress_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = -stress_z.fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_tail_range_vol_of_vol_zscore"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_tail_range_vol_of_vol_zscore"]
description: Parent strength target: RankIC/RankICIR and payoff monotonicity from the negative volatility-of-volatility fragility mechanism. Bottleneck: linear IC/ICIR, because the parent's rolling percentile rank squeezes extreme stress values into uniform ranks and limits the linear signal amplitude. Mutation preserves the same true-range vol-of-vol stress ratio but replaces the rolling percentile rank with a rolling z-score over the same 60-day window. The rolling z-score is monotonic in stress, so the rank ordering is preserved and RankIC should remain stable, while retaining continuous magnitude information to improve linear IC/ICIR. The negative sign is unchanged. This is a raw single-stock factor; no cross-sectional transform is applied.
